x: The songs of Miss Doris Gray and Miss Grace Kirkpatrick were heartily applauded, and a jolly Yorkshireman of our company caused amusement when his simple heart was touched and he made love to the fair ones.
Then came Miss Grace Kirkpatrick. I think everybody knows how well she can sing, and it was with general regret that time prevented her from singing more than two numbers.
Miss Grace Kirkpatrick also delighted us in her usual manner, and two friends of Miss Parsons, of the "L.O.'s" gave skipping and dancing duets which were greatly appreciated.
